scope.description_review: Catalogue-wide structural checks and targeted factual/visual review; not a verification of every historical or production claim.
scope.colours: Broad visible colour families, not authentication of paper, ink shades or printing varieties.

limitations.issue: Existing placeholder entries have no image files.
